transport_policy.json_fallback: Canonical JSON with identical identifiers, provenance, completeness, continuation, limits, omissions, and recommended actions
transport_policy.binary: Native MCP image/resource content plus a structured companion envelope; never an unlabeled or silently truncated byte prefix

scope.description: Authorized notebook/source/document/version scope; absent only when the operation has no resource scope.

coverage.description: Requested, searched, unavailable, disabled, failed, omitted, and exhausted scopes/representations.

error.description: Stable typed and sanitized failure envelope.

continuation.format: CursorCodecV2 (mnc2) with signed format version, domain, key ID, issued/expiry timestamps, immutable snapshot, binding, position, and effective limits
continuation.rotation: Issue only with the active key; accept named overlap keys only while configured and before token expiry; retired/unknown keys require traversal restart.
continuation.legacy_delivery: Delivery-v1 cursors are decode-only until the process-stable configured overlap deadline; all new delivery cursors are V2.
continuation.client_rule: Pass next_cursor unchanged to the same operation until it is null or the requested selector is complete.
continuation.server_rule: Reauthorize every page; reject tampering, expiry, wrong actor/notebook/version/generation/query/selector, and scope widening.
continuation.complete_rule: complete is valid only when the declared scope and required representations are exhausted; ranked top-k is never exhaustive.

tools.name: list_notebooks
tools.responsibility: Bounded notebook inventory for scope discovery.
use_when: The caller needs available notebook IDs or a notebook inventory page.
recommended_chain: Use a returned notebook_id with notebook-scoped retrieval tools.
tools.compatibility: Preserve Phase 8 semantics and required inputs.

tools.name: get_notebook_summary
use_when: A coarse notebook overview is sufficient.
do_not_use_when: Exact evidence, exhaustive results, arithmetic, or exact location is required.
tools.completeness: Summary coverage is not document or corpus completeness.
recommended_chain: Use search_evidence or exact delivery for supporting evidence.

tools.name: search_all_notebooks
tools.responsibility: Bounded ranked canonical-text discovery across notebooks.
use_when: Finding relevant canonical chunks, documents, and propagated notebook/document/version IDs.
tools.completeness: Always bounded ranked/unknown with respect to all matches; never complete enumeration.
recommended_chain: For exact location or full content, pass IDs to get_document/get_document_chunk.
For typed/derived or exhaustive evidence, call search_evidence.
tools.compatibility: Do not change V1 ranking, plan, top-k, or required inputs.

tools.name: query_notebook
tools.responsibility: Bounded V1 evidence retrieval and optional synthesis within one notebook.
use_when: A relevant top-k V1 text answer in one known notebook is sufficient.
tools.completeness: Bounded ranked V1; no exhaustive guarantee.
recommended_chain: Use get_document for exact source traversal.
Use run_final_qa_v2 only for typed V2 evidence/publication.
tools.compatibility: V1 Final-QA and citation semantics remain frozen.

tools.name: get_source_insights
tools.responsibility: Return bounded persisted insights for one known source.
use_when: The source ID is known and persisted facts/entities are requested.
recommended_chain: Use exact delivery for original supporting content.

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.responsibility: Return bounded persisted chronological events in a notebook/source scope.
do_not_use_when: Complete document traversal or arbitrary exhaustive fact extraction
tools.completeness: Completeness applies to persisted timeline events, not all possible events in source text.
recommended_chain: Retrieve cited exact evidence when needed.

tools.name: get_document
tools.responsibility: Bounded exact-version document traversal or original-byte delivery.
use_when: The request asks for full, page/range, first/last, from-end, or exact structural content
do_not_use_when: Discovering a relevant document from natural language
Semantic or exhaustive matching across documents
tools.completeness: Continue unchanged next_cursor until null for full traversal; selector scope must terminate complete or report typed limitation.
recommended_chain: Use search_all_notebooks/search_evidence to discover IDs.
For full/end requests, continue until selector completion; do not answer from search snippets.
tools.compatibility: Existing no-selector blocks/original modes and optional safe notebook resolution remain compatible.

tools.name: get_document_chunk
tools.responsibility: Return one exact authorized canonical chunk and ancestry.
use_when: A canonical chunk ID is already known and exact chunk content/context is needed.
tools.completeness: Complete for the one exact chunk resource only.
recommended_chain: Use search to discover chunk/document/version IDs first.
tools.compatibility: Preserve existing digest and output behavior; enrich provenance additively.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.responsibility: List authorized occurrences in a known scope or deliver one known original asset occurrence.
use_when: Document/version or occurrence ID is already known
do_not_use_when: Finding an image from a natural-language description
tools.completeness: Inventory completeness is separate from atomic binary-resource completeness.
recommended_chain: Use search_evidence for semantic asset discovery.
Use get_image_analysis for derived interpretation of a returned occurrence.
tools.compatibility: Retain inventory/selected-occurrence modes; do not turn asset ID into authority.

tools.name: get_image_analysis
tools.responsibility: Deliver bounded authorized OCR and/or Vision derivations for one occurrence.
use_when: An occurrence is known and derived text/description/entities/regions are requested.
do_not_use_when: Discovering which image matches natural language
Treating derived output as source truth
tools.completeness: Per requested analysis kind and derivation coverage; missing analysis is unavailable, not empty image content.
recommended_chain: Use get_asset for the original image.
Use selection=latest_ready when explicit IDs are not known and policy permits.
tools.compatibility: Existing explicit derivation IDs remain supported; deterministic selection is additive.

tools.name: search_evidence
tools.responsibility: Ranked or bounded exhaustive typed evidence discovery across requested representations and authorized scope; optional explicit document partitions preserve per-document completeness and provenance.
use_when: OCR/Vision/asset metadata/compatible visual or multilingual evidence must be searched
Evidence IDs are needed for delivery
tools.completeness: Ranked is bounded/unknown; exhaustive can be complete only after all declared sources terminate.
recommended_chain: Pass document IDs to get_document, occurrence IDs to get_asset/get_image_analysis, or typed evidence to run_final_qa_v2.
tools.compatibility: Additive; never changes search_all_notebooks. Derived and multilingual sources are advertised only when their active generation/provider is ready; language provenance remains in the evidence locator.

tools.name: query_structured
tools.responsibility: Discover an authorized exact-version dataset/schema or execute a typed bounded structured filter/sort/group/aggregate over an active projection.
use_when: Numeric comparisons, ranges, counts, averages, sorting, grouping, or deterministic structured comparison are required.
Use operation=describe before query when the dataset identity or schema is unknown.
do_not_use_when: The dataset has no validated structured projection
Free-text semantic relevance is the requested operation
Arbitrary SQL, expressions, semantic joins, or image operations are requested
tools.completeness: Derived from exact row-universe exhaustion; stale/ambiguous/unavailable projection never returns complete.
recommended_chain: Use search_evidence first only to identify the correct dataset/projection.
Use run_final_qa_v2 for a cited narrative over the result.
tools.compatibility: Additive; no SQL string input and no V1 search changes.

tools.name: run_final_qa_v2
tools.responsibility: Persist and replay a citation-compliant Final-QA V2 answer over typed authorized evidence.
use_when: A grounded persisted answer over V2 typed evidence is required.
tools.completeness: Propagates evidence/context completeness; failed citation compliance publishes no assistant snapshot.
recommended_chain: Retrieve exact/structured/multimodal evidence first unless the accepted request contract performs deterministic retrieval.
tools.compatibility: Additive and reuses ADR-0054/ADR-0056; V1 Final-QA unchanged.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.responsibility: Return truthful scope-aware Phase 8.5 readiness, active generation, bounds, and limitations.
use_when: A client needs to choose a supported tool/path or explain an unavailable modality.
tools.completeness: Complete for known capabilities visible to the actor; inaccessible implementation details are intentionally omitted.
recommended_chain: Choose only exposed and ready capability paths; treat unavailable/disabled/policy-denied as non-searchable.
tools.compatibility: Additive; replaces no static V1 capability behavior.
